reading.title: The Role of Neuroplasticity in Learning
reading.passage: Neuroplasticity refers to the brain's remarkable ability to reorganize itself by forming new neural connections throughout life. Recent neuroscience research demonstrates that the brain is not fixed but constantly adapts in response to experience and learning. When individuals practice a skill repeatedly, neural pathways strengthen, making tasks easier over time. This phenomenon explains why musicians develop enhanced auditory processing and why stroke patients can recover lost functions. Understanding neuroplasticity has revolutionized educational approaches, emphasizing that intelligence and abilities are not innate but can be developed through deliberate practice and effort.

vocabulary.meaning_ko: 신경가소성, 뇌가 새로운 신경 연결을 형성하여 재조직화되는 능력

questions.q: According to the passage, what is neuroplasticity?
options: A. The brain's fixed ability to process information from birth
B. The brain's ability to reorganize itself by forming new neural connections
C. A condition that prevents the brain from changing after childhood
D. The reduction of neural pathways through aging
questions.explanation: 지문의 첫 문장에서 neuroplasticity를 '뇌가 평생에 걸쳐 새로운 신경 연결을 형성하여 자신을 재조직화하는 놀라운 능력'으로 정의하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about the brain's intelligence?
options: A. Intelligence is completely fixed at birth and cannot change
B. Intelligence and abilities can be developed through practice and effort
C. Only musicians and stroke patients can improve their brain function
D. The brain stops adapting after a person reaches adulthood
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 'intelligence and abilities are not innate but can be developed through deliberate practice and effort(지능과 능력은 타고나는 것이 아니라 의도적인 연습과 노력을 통해 발전할 수 있다)'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Governments should implement comprehensive policies to address low birth rates, such as providing childcare subsidies and parental leave benefits. Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
model_sentences: I strongly agree that governments should implement comprehensive policies to address low birth rates, including childcare subsidies and parental leave benefits, because these measures directly support families and strengthen society.
First, affordable childcare subsidies reduce the financial burden on parents, making it more feasible for couples to have children without sacrificing their careers or financial stability.

For example, countries like Sweden and France have successfully implemented generous parental leave policies and childcare support, resulting in relatively higher birth rates compared to nations without such programs.
Second, these policies recognize that raising children requires both time and money, and government support demonstrates a commitment to family well-being, which encourages people to have children.

In conclusion, comprehensive government policies addressing low birth rates are essential because they provide practical support to families and ultimately benefit society's long-term sustainability and economic growth.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer spending time with friends. Others prefer spending time with family. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details.
model_sentences: I personally prefer spending time with my family because family relationships are foundational and irreplaceable in my life.
Family members have known me my whole life and understand me deeply, so I feel comfortable being myself without any pretense.
For instance, when I'm stressed about school or work, my family's support feels more meaningful because they've supported me through everything since childhood.
Of course, friends are important too, but I believe family bonds should come first because they provide unconditional love and support that lasts a lifetime.

listening.title: Economics Lecture: Supply and Demand
listening.script: Professor: Good morning, everyone. Today we're discussing one of the most fundamental concepts in economics: supply and demand. Let me explain how these two forces interact in a market. Supply refers to the quantity of goods that producers are willing to offer at various prices. Demand, on the other hand, is the quantity of goods that consumers are willing to buy at different prices. When demand increases but supply remains constant, what happens? Prices tend to rise because consumers are competing for the same limited quantity. Conversely, when supply increases but demand stays the same, prices typically fall because producers have more goods competing for the same number of buyers. The equilibrium point, where supply equals demand, determines the market price. Let me give you a practical example. During the COVID-19 pandemic, face mask demand skyrocketed, but supply couldn't keep up initially, so prices increased dramatically. Later, as manufacturers increased production, prices gradually decreased. This real-world scenario perfectly demonstrates how supply and demand determine market prices. Understanding this concept is crucial because it affects everything from housing to food prices in your daily life.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the lecture?
options: A. How to increase prices in competitive markets
B. The relationship between supply, demand, and market prices
C. Why face mask production increased during COVID-19
D. Different strategies for consumer shopping behavior
questions.explanation: 강의의 시작부터 공급과 수요가 시장 가격에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지에 대해 설명하고 있으며, 이것이 핵심 주제입니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, what happens when demand increases but supply remains constant?
options: A. Prices decrease because there is more competition among producers
B. Prices remain the same because equilibrium is maintained
C. Prices rise because consumers compete for limited goods
D. Supply automatically increases to match the demand
questions.explanation: 교수는 '수요가 증가하지만 공급이 일정하면, 소비자들이 제한된 수량의 상품을 놓고 경쟁하기 때문에 가격이 상승한다'고 명시했습니다.

questions.q: Why does the professor mention the face mask example?
options: A. To explain that COVID-19 permanently increased face mask demand
B. To demonstrate how supply and demand principles work in real-world situations
C. To argue that manufacturers should have produced more masks earlier
D. To show that prices always increase during health crises
questions.explanation: 교수는 '이 실제 사례는 공급과 수요가 시장 가격을 어떻게 결정하는지를 완벽하게 보여준다'고 직접 설명했습니다.
